store: Couldn't confirm the repository references were read or saved. Refresh before retrying; a change may have taken effect.
remote: Use a repository's HTTP(S) or git SSH link without credentials. Repository pages are accepted. For a self-hosted GitHub or GitLab, choose the provider.
metadata: Couldn't read these details. Use a name and up to 10 aliases of at most 80 characters each, and a purpose of at most 500 characters.
duplicate: This assistant already has a reference to that repository.
conflict: The saved references changed, or this undo has expired. Reload and retry.
not_found: This repository reference is no longer bound to this assistant.
full: This assistant can save up to 200 repository references.
readonly: This device can only view repository references.
unavailable: Couldn't confirm this repository exists. It may be private, invisible or unavailable. Check the address and visibility; nothing was saved.
authentication: The instance requires authentication or refused the anonymous check. Existence is unconfirmed; nothing was saved.
rate_limited: The instance limited verification requests. Retry later; nothing was saved.
inconclusive: The response didn't confirm this repository's identity. Sign-in pages and redirects aren't verification; nothing was saved.
network: Couldn't reach the repository metadata service. Check the connection and retry; nothing was saved.
timeout: The repository check timed out. Retry; nothing was saved.
unsafe_target: This destination isn't allowed for repository checks. Private instances need an explicitly trusted instance and network in the assistant's configuration; nothing was saved.
canceled: The repository check was canceled. Nothing was saved.
no_provider: {provider} isn't installed. Install it in Settings › Extensions, then try again; nothing was saved.
provider_off: {provider} is off or not running. Turn it on in Settings › Extensions, then try again; nothing was saved.
provider_not_found: {provider} can't find this repository. Check the address and your access; nothing was saved.
provider_not_signed_in: {provider} isn't signed in. Check its settings in Settings › Extensions; nothing was saved.
providers_starting: Extensions are still starting. Try again in a moment; nothing was saved.
